title: Conditional-on-rich-R last-fall-degree drop
conditions_on: R via pre-screen predictor on x(R)
stated_f_in_catalogue: more than 5% of R at d_F <= generic-1
ceiling_check: one degree drop gives per-PDP gain <= ((nb+d)/d)^omega (constant when nb about d)
ceiling_result: p^(1/m) needs a drop of about n/(m*omega) degrees; the mechanism states 1

title: Heavy-tail m-ary decomposition buckets under homography orbits
conditions_on: R via orbit cell of phi(R)
stated_f_in_catalogue: bucket measure >= 1/poly(log p) with a growing relative rate
ceiling_check: bucket yield <= 1/f <= poly(log p); a growing multiple forces the bucket measure to shrink, and the screen then binds at m=3,4

title: Max-load (L-infinity) factor-base sieve: multi-decomposer targets
stated_f_in_catalogue: P(m_F>=2) not stated; measured ratio growing with |F|
ceiling_check: yield identity: sum over R of m_S(R) = |S|^m, so yield gain <= 1/f; multi-decomposer class has f about mu^2 (constant)
ceiling_result: constant if f is constant (lead normalisation mu=1/m!); under the R8 normalisation f is about mu^2 and this bound does not bind, so the Poisson tail (its own falsifier) decides, not this ceiling
disposition: sieve-pricing only; undecided by this ceiling under R8 normalisation

title: Heavy-tail character-weighted factor base
ceiling_check: sum over R of m_S(R) = |S|^m is fixed by base size; a tail base can only concentrate yield on an R-class of measure f (cap 1/f)
ceiling_result: not an R-conditioning mechanism; cap applies to any R-class it concentrates on
disposition: unaffected by R-conditioning; sieve-pricing only (R8 mean 1.04x)

title: ParaDrop: parametric signature-drop locus (special targets R)
stated_f_in_catalogue: measure does not shrink to o(1) (catalogue claim)
ceiling_check: f <= D/p for a univariate locus; screen needs p/D candidates; steering onto the locus costs >= sqrt(p) (its own falsifier)
ceiling_result: screen budget exceeded unless D >= p^(1/2+1/m)
